hypothesis: Fewer Euler integration steps may reduce action-chunk generation latency with an acceptable task-success tradeoff.
model_selection: Use phase1_baseline at 5000 updates regardless of whether LoRA achieves a higher success rate.

latency_protocol.scope: Same held-out observation, model action-chunk generation only, with CUDA synchronization. Excludes preprocessing, simulation, rendering, and action postprocessing.
latency_protocol.summary: Median of the two order-specific median measurements for each sampling setting. Preserve every raw measurement.

descriptive_acceptance_rules.disclosure: Publish both settings even when these criteria fail. This is an engineering screen, not a statistical noninferiority claim.

scope: Controlled inference-setting ablation of an existing open-source sampler; no claim of an original algorithm.
outcome_policy: Do not scan more step counts to select a favorable result. If baseline success is low, investigate policy/data/interface failures before discussing lossless acceleration.
